nodes.title: Fix magnitude calculation in bode_magnitude_numerical_data
nodes.description: Modify the `bode_magnitude_numerical_data` function in sympy/physics/control/control_plots.py. The current implementation uses `mag = 20*log(Abs(w_expr), 10)` which produces `nan` values when computing Bode magnitude for transfer functions with complex coefficients. The fix requires: (1) Update the import statement from `from sympy.functions import arg, Abs` to `from sympy.functions import arg, Abs, re, im, sqrt`. (2) Replace the magnitude calculation `mag = 20*log(Abs(w_expr), 10)` with a more robust approach: `mag_re = re(w_expr)`, `mag_im = im(w_expr)`, `mag = sqrt(mag_re**2 + mag_im**2)`, `mag = 20*log(mag, 10)`. This computes the magnitude as the square root of the sum of squared real and imaginary parts, which is numerically more stable for complex expressions.
nodes.expected_output: The COMPLETE modified Python file with the fix applied. Not a fragment. Not just the fixed function. The entire file from the first import to the last line.
